candidates.reason: Web access returned 403; actual mesh and internal segmentation not inspected. A scan cannot be assumed to contain hidden internals.
Listing explicitly describes exterior detail without internals; different 3.2-litre variant. No model downloaded or purchased.

observations.notes: Fan ring, eleven blades, drive belt, black ducts and transverse silencer.
Six intake throats, dark canopy and routed ignition wiring.
Unrestored 901/01; Solex bodies and ribbed metal valve covers.
Separate finned head, cylinder, hollow piston, rings, pin and valves.
Separate crankpins/rods, flywheel, pulley and bearing parts.
Duplex chain, camshaft, rocker, guide rails and tensioner.
